  -- cumulative scores up to and including the scoring event
  SUM(CASE WHEN (pbp.team_alias = 'WILDCATS' AND pbp.score_change IS NOT NULL) THEN pbp.score_change ELSE 0 END)
    OVER (PARTITION BY pbp.game_id ORDER BY pbp.elapsed_time_sec ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS Wildcats_score,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (pbp.team_alias = 'FIGHTING IRISH' AND pbp.score_change IS NOT NULL) THEN pbp.score_change ELSE 0 END)
    OVER (PARTITION BY pbp.game_id ORDER BY pbp.elapsed_time_sec ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS Fighting_Irish_score,
  pbp.team_market AS scoring_team,
  -- use play_description or event_description-like field; try multiple possible columns
  COALESCE(pbp.event_text, pbp.play_text, pbp.description, pbp.event_description, pbp.details) AS description
FROM (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE season = 2014
    AND home_market = 'Wildcats'
    AND away_market = 'Fighting Irish'
) pbp
WHERE
  -- keep only scoring plays: points scored > 0 in common score columns
  -- try common column names for points on the play
  COALESCE(pbp.points, pbp.points_scored, pbp.score_change, pbp.points_game_delta, pbp.score_delta) IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(pbp.points, pbp.points_scored, pbp.score_change, pbp.points_game_delta, pbp.score_delta) > 0
ORDER BY pbp.elapsed_time_sec ASC

SELECT t.market AS team_market,
       t.name AS team_name,
       COUNT(*) AS peak_season_count
FROM (
  SELECT season, market, name, wins,
         MAX(wins) OVER (PARTITION BY season) AS season_max_wins
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons`
  WHERE season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
    AND name IS NOT NULL
    AND name != ''
) AS t
WHERE t.wins = t.season_max_wins
GROUP BY team_market, team_name
ORDER BY peak_season_count DESC
LIMIT 5

-- Combined top-5 lists for four categories as requested
WITH
-- 1) Top Venues by capacity (use mbb_teams.venue_* and show Date as 'N/A')
top_venues AS (
  SELECT
    'Top Venues' AS category,
    'N/A' AS date,
    COALESCE(venue_name, market) AS matchup_or_venue,
    CAST(venue_capacity AS INT64) AS key_metric,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY venue_capacity DESC NULLS LAST, venue_name) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_teams`
  WHERE venue_capacity IS NOT NULL
),

-- 2) Biggest Championship Margins since 2016 (season > 2015) from historical tournament games
big_champs AS (
  SELECT
    'Biggest Championship Margins' AS category,
    CAST(game_date AS STRING) AS date,
    CONCAT(win_market, ' vs ', lose_market) AS matchup_or_venue,
    ABS(win_pts - lose_pts) AS key_metric,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(win_pts - lose_pts) DESC, game_date) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
  WHERE season > 2015
    -- filter to National Championship games: in this dataset final rounds are typically round = 2 (or check by round value)
    -- Use round = 2 (final) if present; otherwise include tournament = 'NCAA' and round indicative of final
    AND (round = 2 OR LOWER(tournament) LIKE '%ncaa%' OR LOWER(tournament) LIKE '%national%')
    AND win_pts IS NOT NULL
    AND lose_pts IS NOT NULL
),

-- 3) Highest Scoring Games since 2011 (season > 2010) by total points from Sportradar games table (mbb_games_sr)
high_scoring AS (
  SELECT
    'Highest Scoring Games' AS category,
    CAST(scheduled_date AS STRING) AS date,
    CONCAT(h_market, ' vs ', a_market) AS matchup_or_venue,
    CAST(COALESCE(h_points, 0) + COALESCE(a_points, 0) AS INT64) AS key_metric,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(COALESCE(h_points, 0) + COALESCE(a_points, 0) AS INT64) DESC, scheduled_date) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      game_id,
      scheduled_date,
      -- home and away market fields
      h_market,
      a_market,
      -- attempt to get home and away points from available columns; different columns exist across snapshots.
      -- common columns: h_points, a_points, home_points, away_points
      -- use COALESCE to pick whichever exists
      COALESCE(h_points, home_points, CAST(NULL AS INT64)) AS h_points,
      COALESCE(a_points, away_points, CAST(NULL AS INT64)) AS a_points
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_games_sr`
    WHERE season > 2010
  )
  WHERE h_points IS NOT NULL AND a_points IS NOT NULL
),

-- 4) Total Threes since 2011 (season > 2010) by total three-pointers made combined
total_threes AS (
  SELECT
    'Total Threes' AS category,
    CAST(scheduled_date AS STRING) AS date,
    CONCAT(h_market, ' vs ', a_market) AS matchup_or_venue,
    CAST(COALESCE(h_fg3m, 0) + COALESCE(a_fg3m, 0) AS INT64) AS key_metric,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(COALESCE(h_fg3m, 0) + COALESCE(a_fg3m, 0) AS INT64) DESC, scheduled_date) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      game_id,
      scheduled_date,
      h_market,
      a_market,
      -- common 3pt made columns could be h_fg3m / a_fg3m or home_fg3m / away_fg3m; use COALESCE
      COALESCE(h_fg3m, home_fg3m, CAST(NULL AS INT64)) AS h_fg3m,
      COALESCE(a_fg3m, away_fg3m, CAST(NULL AS INT64)) AS a_fg3m
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_games_sr`
    WHERE season > 2010
  )
  WHERE h_fg3m IS NOT NULL AND a_fg3m IS NOT NULL
),

-- select top 5 from each
top5 AS (
  SELECT category, date, matchup_or_venue, key_metric FROM top_venues WHERE rn <= 5
  UNION ALL
  SELECT category, date, matchup_or_venue, key_metric FROM big_champs WHERE rn <= 5
  UNION ALL
  SELECT category, date, matchup_or_venue, key_metric FROM high_scoring WHERE rn <= 5
  UNION ALL
  SELECT category, date, matchup_or_venue, key_metric FROM total_threes WHERE rn <= 5
)

SELECT category, date, matchup_or_venue AS matchup_or_venue_or_venue, key_metric
FROM top5
ORDER BY
  -- maintain grouping by category with rows in descending metric order
  CASE category
    WHEN 'Top Venues' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Biggest Championship Margins' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Highest Scoring Games' THEN 3
    WHEN 'Total Threes' THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END,
  key_metric DESC,
  date

SELECT
  shot_type,
  COUNT(1) AS total_attempts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN shot_made THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_made,
  AVG(adjusted_x) AS avg_x,
  AVG(adjusted_y) AS avg_y,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN shot_made THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(1)) AS pct_made
FROM (
  SELECT
    shot_type,
    shot_made,
    event_coord_x,
    event_coord_y,
    team_basket,
    -- Adjust coordinates to be relative to the basket the team is attacking.
    -- First normalize so that for each event we treat the attacking basket as the "right" basket logic used by the provided coordinate rules.
    -- Apply the provided coordinate transformation using event_coord_x to determine side, then flip if team is attacking the opposite basket.
    -- Step A: compute base adjusted coords per provided rules (as if attacking right basket)
    CASE
      WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN event_coord_x
      ELSE 1128 - event_coord_x
    END AS base_x,
    CASE
      WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN 600 - event_coord_y
      ELSE event_coord_y
    END AS base_y,
    -- Step B: if team_basket indicates the team is attacking the "left" basket, mirror the base_x around half-court (i.e. 564) to keep coordinates consistent to attacking basket.
    CASE
      WHEN team_basket IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN LOWER(team_basket) = 'right' THEN
        CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN event_coord_x ELSE 1128 - event_coord_x END
      WHEN LOWER(team_basket) = 'left' THEN
        -- mirror base_x: since base_x is distance from left baseline when treating right as attack, flip to distance from attacking baseline
        1128 - CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN event_coord_x ELSE 1128 - event_coord_x END
      ELSE
        CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN event_coord_x ELSE 1128 - event_coord_x END
    END AS adjusted_x,
    CASE
      WHEN team_basket IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN LOWER(team_basket) = 'right' THEN
        CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN 600 - event_coord_y ELSE event_coord_y END
      WHEN LOWER(team_basket) = 'left' THEN
        -- for y, mirror similarly: use 600 - base_y
        600 - CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN 600 - event_coord_y ELSE event_coord_y END
      ELSE
        CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN 600 - event_coord_y ELSE event_coord_y END
    END AS adjusted_y
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE
    scheduled_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-03-15')
    AND shot_type IS NOT NULL
    AND event_coord_x IS NOT NULL
    AND event_coord_y IS NOT NULL
    AND event_type IN ('shot', 'field goal', 'shot attempt', 'shot made') -- include likely shot event types
)
WHERE adjusted_x IS NOT NULL AND adjusted_y IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY shot_type
ORDER BY total_attempts DESC
